author: Claude (English teacher role)
basis: Rewritten from the A2 column of sheet 'SDG 5-1'. Same meaning, same slide order, same facts (2030 target, STEM for girls, wage gap, unpaid work at home). Spec: <=32 words per slide, <=10 words per sentence, present simple, high-frequency vocabulary.

slides.1: Hello everyone. Today we talk about SDG 5. SDG 5 means gender equality. Boys and girls must have the same rights and the same dreams.
slides.2: Why is this important? Fairness is good for everyone. When girls do well, families grow stronger. Schools get better too.
slides.3: Think about a bird. A bird needs two wings to fly. Our world needs two wings too: men and women.
slides.4: In the past, people had old ideas. They said boys can be doctors. They said girls must stay home. These ideas stop children.
slides.5: These ideas start when we are very young. We give trucks to boys. We give dolls to girls. Every child can play with any toy.
slides.6: In some poor places, girls leave school early. They cannot read or write. Then they cannot get good jobs. We must change this.
slides.7: Now look at jobs. Many women get less money than men. They do the same work. Same work needs same pay.
slides.8: There are not many women bosses. We see many men in big offices. We need more women leaders. Women have great ideas.
slides.9: Women also do a lot of work at home. They clean, cook, and care for babies. Men and boys must help too.
slides.10: How do we start? We start with respect. Listen to your classmates. Do not say a job is only for boys.
slides.11: At home we can share the work. Boys can cook dinner. Girls can fix bicycles. When everyone helps, the home is happy.
slides.12: Do you see someone being unkind? Then speak up. Be a brave friend at school. Small actions can change a life.
slides.13: Things are changing now. More girls learn coding and robots. STEM is for everyone. Girls can be scientists and engineers.
slides.14: The internet helps girls learn at home. In far villages, girls watch school lessons online. Technology brings the world to them.
slides.15: We see many strong women in sports and online. They are fast and smart. Their stories help young people.
slides.16: Many countries make new, fair laws. These laws give women safe jobs and good pay. Then the country grows stronger.
slides.17: Today we learned one thing. Gender equality is important for all of us. It is not a dream. It is a real goal.
slides.18: I promise to respect boys and girls. I will help all my friends. What about you? Choose one small action today.
slides.19: Big change takes time. But we can build a fair world by 2030. Let us be the people who make it real.
slides.20: SDG 5 is a mission for you and me. When we are equal, we are stronger. Thank you for listening.
